messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high-sev billing spike for customer 'Alcyon Health' in VPC dedicated pool. Tokenization mismatch suspected — observed 3-5x token counts vs expected. Please ACK and start triage.
Maya: ACK — I'm on-call. Can someone post sample payloads and the stack (vpc/dedicated pool id)?
Lila (Alcyon Ops): thanks, we're seeing major overage alerts in our billing dashboard. VPC id vpc-az3-alcyon, dedicated-pool dpool-07. Sending a redacted sample payload now.
Lila (Alcyon Ops): "payload (redacted): \n\u201cpatient_note\u201d: \"Dr. Rao\u2019s notes: patient\ud83d\ude00...'\""
Samir: copied. Jorge, can you show the token counts from the tokenizer service for that exact payload?
Jorge: pasting logs snippet: 
```
2026-11-02T14:12:03Z tokenizer: request_id=abc123 customer=alcyon input_len=823 bytes token_count=4123 tokenizer=redwood-bpe-v2 detected_encoding=utf-8
2026-11-02T14:12:03Z tokenizer: request_id=abc124 customer=alcyon input_len=823 bytes token_count=1289 tokenizer=redwood-bpe-v2 detected_encoding=utf-16le
```
Jorge: Notice same byte length but tokenizer sometimes reports utf-16le detected and token_count drops accordingly — inconsistent detection logic. Looks like surrogate pairs / embedded NULLs are confusing the detector.
eng-ml: probable root cause: customer client libs (internal Alcyon) are serializing strings with UTF-16LE or adding hidden BOMs and null bytes. Our tokenizer detector heuristics flip between treating input as UTF-8 vs UTF-16 which yields wildly different tokenization.
Priya: Impact summary? Are other tenants affected or is this isolated to the Alcyon VPC pool?
Jorge: so far isolated to Alcyon dedicated pool. We believe tenant isolation is working — compute and qps unaffected. The main problem is billing/token-metering and generated outputs being longer than customer expects (affects SLA/cost).
Maya: immediate mitigations we can do now (short-term):
- throttle/police: apply a soft cap to per-request token accounting for Alcyon (temporary ceiling e.g., 5000 tokens) to prevent runaway billing.
- normalization: enable server-side pre-normalization to strip null chars and normalize surrogate pairs for this tenant only.
- billing: put disputed usage on invoice hold while we investigate (CS + Finance).
Samir: I can push the tenant-level normalization toggle to the canary for Alcyon in 30m. Steps: update tokenizer config for dpool-07 to set `force_normalize_encoding=true` and `strip_control_chars=true`. Jorge can you create the canary deploy?
Jorge: on it. Will deploy canary to a single node in dpool-07 and tail logs. DeployBot: started canary deploy job 98765 -> node gpu-24 in dpool-07.
DeployBot: canary health: initializing, will report back at 14:40 UTC.
Lila (Alcyon Ops): appreciate the quick response. Our CS lead asked to confirm whether this will change model outputs significantly (medical text integrity).
eng-ml: normalization will only remove non-printable control chars and normalize Unicode composition (NFC). We won't rewrite punctuation or content other than invisible chars. But we will run sample diff checks and surface any changed tokenization.
Priya: who's owner for billing credit + customer comms?
CS-Leads: CS will handle comms and coordinate invoice hold. Assigning to Maya + Finance.
Maya: I will raise the invoice hold and coordinate credits. ETA 2 hours for initial credit calculation.
Samir: action items summary: 
- Samir: enable `force_normalize_encoding` canary (30m) -> then roll to all dpool-07 nodes if green.
- Jorge: canary deploy + logs + token-count before/after (30-60m).
- eng-ml: produce short PR to improve encoding detector heuristics and add fallback to treat ambiguous payloads as UTF-8 after normalization (patch ETA 6h).
- Maya + Finance + CS: place invoice hold and draft customer credit (ETA 2h).
- Lila (Alcyon Ops): provide additional sample payloads from their clients and confirm whether any clients changed SDK/language (JS/Java).
- Priya: update the incidents runbook with tenant-level token normalization steps and the billing dispute flow.
Samir: temporary config snippet I'm pushing: 
```
# tenant override for alcyon
tenant_overrides:
  alcyon:
    force_normalize_encoding: true
    strip_control_chars: true
    max_tokens_per_request: 5000
```
Jorge: after canary, I'll run a backfill token re-count job on last 24h of logs to compute disputed tokens. That job will need permission to read dpool-07 logs and will take ~45m.
Lila (Alcyon Ops): customers are asking for a timeline — please keep us updated in this thread and share any remediation docs.
Maya: noted. I'll post a short customer-facing summary once we have canary results.
eng-ml: long-term fix ideas: tighten API to require `content-encoding` header, improve BOM/null stripping in ingestion layer, and add deterministic encoding detection based on heuristics + confidence threshold. Also consider charging only after normalization step in billing pipeline to avoid raw-metering discrepancies.
Samir: rolling canary now. Will update thread when canary is healthy or if rollback needed.
DeployBot: canary 98765 -> node gpu-24: health=green at 14:42 UTC. Logs show normalized token_count for sample -> 1286 (previously 4123).
Jorge: initial backfill run started. Early numbers look like 3.6x overcount on ~1200 requests in last 24h.
CS-Leads: please prepare a credit estimate based on reduced token counts; we will present to Alcyon.
Maya: starting invoice hold + draft credit calc now.
Lila (Alcyon Ops): :thumbsup: thanks everyone. We'll stand by.
Maya: follow-ups: eng-ml PR (link once open), billing adjustment ticket to Finance (FIN-3012), customer comms draft (CS-ALCYON-2026-11-02). Closing loop in 3h or sooner with final numbers.
Samir: canary looks stable, starting gradual rollout to rest of dpool-07. If we see regressions -> rollback and notify.
Jorge: backfill complete, posting CSV summary to secure drive and linking in the incident ticket.
IncidentBot: Incident updated: severity -> mitigated (billing risk contained), on-call: Maya remains primary.
Maya: marking P0->P1 for now while we finish billing reconciliation. Will hand off to oncall rotation lead for overnight.
Priya: I'll add this incident to the tokenizer runbook and schedule a postmortem tomorrow.
CS-Leads: noted. We'll coordinate a customer briefing after postmortem.
Maya: thanks team.
